title: Case: Workshop asks for confirmation of unloading equipment on tomorrow's pallet delivery
context: Three pallets of shelving are planned for Thursday morning on a standard vehicle. The receiving site's forklift is out of service and it asked the desk to get a tail-lift and pallet truck added.
initial_request: Can you confirm the tail-lift's sorted for tomorrow? I've stood down the two lads I'd borrowed to hand-ball it off the wagon. Need a yes by end of today.

events.body: Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

DL-6682: 3 pallets of shelving, heaviest 410 kg, to Kestrel Yard Workshops. Planned Thursday 2026-04-16 AM on a standard curtain-sider. There is no tail-lift on the plan. Vehicle changes for Thursday have to reach me by 16:00 UTC on Wednesday 2026-04-15. I work from email and from the Freight portal amendments form.
My parcel DL-88767 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

events.from: Kestra Gallimore, receiving coordinator, Kestrel Yard Workshops
events.body: Our forklift is away for repair until the 20th. We need a tail-lift and a pallet truck on the vehicle for DL-6682 or we cannot get the pallets off.
Route plan for depot BR-8 published for Wednesday. 44 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

Thanks,
Eamon
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

Amendment request for DL-6682, Thursday 2026-04-16: the receiving site has no forklift. Please plan a tail-lift vehicle with a pallet truck on board. 3 pallets, heaviest 410 kg. Please confirm the change.

events.to: Kestra Gallimore, receiving coordinator, Kestrel Yard Workshops
events.body: I have sent your tail-lift and pallet truck request for DL-6682 to the carrier's freight planner. I will confirm once they do.

Error FP-5233: your amendment could not be saved. No change was made to DL-6682 and the planner was not notified. The amendments form is unavailable during a planned upgrade until 2026-04-16 06:00 UTC.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
Thursday freight run sheet is out. DL-6682 on vehicle 14, curtain-sider, standard, solo driver. Vehicle allocations are the planner's, we just run what's on the sheet.
Route plan for depot BR-8 published for Thursday. 28 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
FYI DL-6682: three pallets wrapped, banded and collected by the Saltmarrow Arc trunk last night. Paperwork TG-1035 went with the driver. Nothing outstanding our side.

acceptable_actions.summary: Email the freight planner before the 16:00 UTC cut-off asking for a tail-lift vehicle with a pallet truck for DL-6682 on Thursday 2026-04-16, since the site has no forklift, and ask for confirmation of the change.

must: Send the vehicle change request to the Freight planner by Email
Ask for a tail-lift vehicle and a pallet truck for DL-6682 because the receiving site has no forklift
Flag the 16:00 UTC cut-off today or ask for the change before it
Ask the planner to confirm whether the change has been made
must_not: Tell the receiving coordinator the tail-lift is arranged or confirmed for tomorrow
Submit the request again through the Freight portal amendments form
Promise a vehicle type or arrival time the planner has not confirmed
Advise the site to unload the pallets by hand or suggest how to do so
Ask Dispatch to change the vehicle
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-6682, 3 pallets of shelving (heaviest 410 kg) to Kestrel Yard Workshops, Thursday 2026-04-16 AM. The receiving site's forklift is out of service until 2026-04-20, so they cannot unload from a standard curtain-sider. Please plan a tail-lift vehicle with a pallet truck on board. This desk submitted the change on the Freight portal amendments form on 2026-04-14, but the form returned error FP-5233 and nothing was saved; today's run sheet still shows vehicle 14, standard curtain-sider. I know vehicle changes for Thursday must reach you by 16:00 UTC today. Please confirm whether the change can be made, or tell us if it cannot so the site can plan.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-208: people, organisations and references renamed. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
